fixed_before_any_toi_run: this file is committed before the first run of any engine on any of the 24 TOIs (the charter's amendment, section 9: thresholds fixed before the run); no value here is changed after a TOI result is seen

input.light_curves: SPOC 2-minute PDCSAP_FLUX of the verified files (data-check.json), QUALITY == 0, finite; each sector divided by its median
input.ephemeris: each TOI's catalog values as v0.5.9 used them: period_days, epoch_bjd - 2457000, duration_hours, depth_ppm from the v0.5.6 draws (docs/validation/v0.5.6/part-a-draw.json, calibration/v0.5.6/part-b-draw.json)
input.detrending: wotan biweight, the same for every engine that takes a detrended curve

wotan_window_source: window about 3 times the transit duration, as recommended by Hippke, David, Mulders & Heller 2019, AJ 158, 143 (wotan); not confirmed: the paper was not re-read in this phase
tls_bin_reason: cost: the unbinned search was estimated at about 21,000 CPU-s for the 24 TOIs (synthetic calibration, results/synthetic-tls-cost-4s-nobin-b.json), above the phase cap; 10-minute bins (5 SPOC cadences) give about 4,200 CPU-s
tls_period_range_reason: covers twice the longest catalog period of the 24 (8.59 d) and half the shortest (0.515 d is above 0.4); fixed from catalog values, not from results
triceratops_fold_reason: TRICERATOPS takes a phase-folded light curve; the fold is binned, as in the tool's examples, so that the cost stays within the cap

detection.source: Hippke & Heller 2019, A&A 623, A39 (TLS): SDE >= 9 as the detection threshold; not confirmed: the paper was not re-read in this phase

recovery.rule: the TLS period P equals the catalog period times one of 1/3, 1/2, 1, 2, 3 within a relative tolerance of 0.001
recovery.source: Refute's own matching rule (v0.5.6, seeded_run.IDENTITY_TOLERANCE and FACTORS), applied unchanged; not a TLS threshold

Sweet.rule: warning when any amplitude-to-uncertainty ratio at P/2, P or 2P exceeds 3

Centroid.rule: significance below 1e-3 suggests that the target is not the source
Centroid.source: exovetter 0.0.16, vetters.Centroid.run docstring: 'Values less than ~1e-3 suggest the target is not the source of the transit'

ModShift.rule: none published by exovetter: the metrics and its false_alarm_threshold are recorded; outcome 'no_published_threshold'
ModShift.source: exovetter 0.0.16, vetters.ModShift.run returns the metrics only

OddEven.rule: none published by exovetter: oe_sigma is recorded; outcome 'no_published_threshold'
OddEven.source: exovetter 0.0.16, vetters.OddEven.run returns the metrics only

TransitPhaseCoverage.rule: none published by exovetter: the coverage fraction is recorded; outcome 'no_published_threshold'

Lpp.rule: not run: its map file is remote and was not staged as a verified local input; outcome 'unavailable'

triceratops.rule: FPP < 0.015 and NFPP < 0.001; separately, NFPP > 0.1 (two thresholds, each recorded as met or not met)
triceratops.source: Giacalone et al. 2021, AJ 161, 24 (TRICERATOPS); not confirmed: the paper was not re-read in this phase

leo.rule: LEO-Vetter's own default thresholds (leo_vetter.thresholds._default_thresholds) and its own class: any FA test flag gives FA, else any FP test flag gives FP, else PC
leo.source: LEO-Vetter 1.2.0, leo_vetter/thresholds.py and leo_vetter/main.py, read in the installed package on 2026-11-24

wording_rule: report-facing fields never use 'validated', 'likely a nearby false positive', 'confirmed' or 'decide'; a tool's native labels are kept as attributed observations
